backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining all user data types and maps for tasks, notes, timers, profiles, rewards, streaks, and more, with storage and authorization mixins included.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing UI branding, logo replacement, and favicon update requirements with associated files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and functionality of major frontend components and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes with base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting the page title to Scholar Gold and linking favicon/app icon assets.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app container handling authentication, profile setup, tab navigation, and Scholar Gold–branded dashboard layout.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundSettin: UI for purchasing, generating, uploading, and selecting backgrounds with coin costs, rarity tiers, and camera capture support.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer showing copyright text and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component with theme toggle and login/logout handling using Internet Identity and profile dropdown.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login landing screen with product feature cards and Internet Identity login flow.
frontend/src/components/NotesSection.tsx: Notes manager supporting creation, editing, deletion, image uploads, and voice recording for notes.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSection.t: User profile display and editing UI including avatar upload, bio editing, name changes, and coin/streak data.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Initial profile creation dialog collecting name and bio and awarding new users bonus coins.
frontend/src/components/ReminderNotifica: Background component that checks upcoming reminders and triggers notifications when due.
frontend/src/components/RemindersSection: Provides UI for creating reminders, validating input, submitting to backend, and listing upcoming reminders with formatted times.
frontend/src/components/StopwatchSection: Implements a persistent stopwatch synced with backend state, supporting start, pause, reset, and automatic state restoration.
frontend/src/components/TimerSection.tsx: Manages a pomodoro/custom timer with persistence, notifications, session tracking, and integration with coin and streak systems.
frontend/src/components/timetable/DoneTo: Renders a checkbox for marking a timetable entry as completed today, syncing state via backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/timetable/EditTi: Dialog component allowing users to edit a timetable entry’s title and activity type, using mutation hooks and readonly date/time display.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Shows a dialog with a 6‑month completion history for a timetable entry, including stats and a scrollable daily list.
frontend/src/components/TimetableSection: Allows creating, editing, deleting, and viewing timetable entries with typed activity categories and completion history features.
frontend/src/components/TodoSection.tsx: Handles adding tasks, marking completion, and displaying pending and completed tasks with priority labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, handling login, stored identity loading, and exposing identity state to components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profile, coins, backgrounds, and timetable data using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors, radii, and shared UI tokens.
frontend/src/lib/NotificationManager.ts: Utility class for showing toast-based notifications for timers and reminders and managing browser notification permissions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, Internet Identity provider, React Query client, and global styles.
frontend/src/utils/timetableDates.ts: Utility functions for generating date keys and checking if a timestamp corresponds to today.
frontend/src/utils/timetableHistory.ts: Generates date ranges and maps timetable ticks to daily completion states for the last 6 months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config defining theme extensions, color variables, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing planned timetable features, constraints, issues, and image requirements.
